subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 as the fix path for this latest-release `agentTurn` stale `running_at_ms` report, or require a separate live reproduction first?
rationale: Source inspection supports the same buffered due-outcome class, but the reporter's single-cron steps are not live-proven and current main also contains the intended final clear path.

options.title: Review and adapt the open fix PR
options.body: Use the open incremental-finalization PR as the primary path, adding or adjusting proof for this exact recurring isolated `agentTurn` case before closing the issue.

options.title: Require a fresh live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open under needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter proves the single-cron v2026.6.11 scenario against current main or the latest release.

options.title: Split if the root cause differs
options.body: If live proof shows a single-job failure unrelated to due-batch buffering, keep this issue as a distinct cron scheduler bug and do not attach it to the open PR.

recommendation.title: Review and adapt the open fix PR
recommendation.body: Use the open incremental-finalization PR as the primary path, adding or adjusting proof for this exact recurring isolated `agentTurn` case before closing the issue.
